newsitem.title: LEBANON: Guerrillas hit Israel in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Guerrillas hit Israel in Lebanon.

text.p: Three Israeli soldiers were wounded on Saturday in Hizbollah guerrilla attacks inside Israel's south Lebanon occupation zone, pro-Israeli militia sources in Lebanon said.
In Jerusalem, an Israeli army spokeswoman said only one soldier was wounded.
The militia sources said two soldiers were wounded when a Hizbollah rocket hit their tank on the road leading to Kassarat al-Oroush in the eastern sector of the zone.
Earlier, an Israeli soldier was wounded in a mortar bomb attack on his outpost in Ghozlan, they said.

In Jerusalem the Israeli army, asked to check the reports from Lebanon, said only one soldier was wounded in the Kassarat al-Oroush area. An army spokeswoman said no other soldiers were wounded in Lebanon on Saturday.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah claimed responsibility for the attacks.

"A group of fighters hit a Zionist force heading from the Rihan outpost towards Kassarat al-Oroush with adequate weapons. Simultaneously, another group targeted a force heading towards Beir Kallab, achieving a direct hit," Hizbollah said in a statement.
South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia sources said the guerrillas shelled three other Israeli and SLA outposts in the eastern sector of the zone, causing no casualties.
Hizbollah is battling Israeli and SLA troops to try to oust them from the 15-km (nine-mile)-wide south Lebanon occupation zone.
